task.name: Start_flame_effects
task.when: After Zimmer startup passes and immediately before flame-effect operation

step.action: Confirm that 📋 Start_Zimmer_vaporizer passed and the trained spotter is in position.
Confirm that every effect safety valve is closed.
Set the effect regulator to the approved pressure in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure without exceeding 110 psi.
Open the effect-feed valve identified in the approved procedure.
Leak-test the effect feed with 🔥 Propane_Leak_Test_Solution according to the approved procedure.
step.ifThen: IF growing bubbles, propane odor, hissing, or frost is present, THEN complete the approved emergency shutdown and keep the effect out of service.

step.action: Open the pilot regulators and valves in the sequence printed in the approved procedure.
Observe wind direction and confirm that the approved perimeter remains clear.
Light the pilot with 🔥 Flame_Effect_Ignition_Torch using the approved ignition method.
Fire one test poof on the Flame Lead's command.
step.ifThen: IF the flame, sound, pilot, pressure, or controls behave differently from the approved procedure, THEN complete the approved shutdown and keep the effect out of service.

passWhen.criterion: The trained spotter and safety perimeter are in position.
The regulator is at its approved pressure and no leak is present.
The pilot and one test poof operate exactly as described in the approved procedure.
